source_state: uncommitted standalone speculative distribution and policy-callback ownership
behavior: Opaque MlxSpeculativeDistribution keeps lazy processed values and their allocation authority together. It exposes no production raw-array export or dereference.
Logits processing and capture callbacks acquire the selected domain before policy or capture-ledger mutation, including standalone sampling outside prepared generation.
Probability queries, residual construction, sampling and adaptive commitment merge sampler, distribution and RNG authorities before native work; repeated same-domain use reuses existing ownership.

Sampler clones share a mutable authority list because custom policies and capture payloads may share native state, including arrays retained from &self callbacks. No list borrow spans a user callback.

Verification acquires all source and destination authorities before changing any distribution or submitting native work. Empty, zero-temperature and single-stream no-work paths do not acquire a fresh owner.

Nonzero numerical fixtures verify probabilities, positive residuals, greedy sampling, lazy values and CPU/Metal verification. Errors and unwinding retain authority through native recovery and preserve original causes.
Five explicit Metal scheduler cases preserve CPU-draft/GPU-target execution, same-device handoff without producer synchronization, optimistic lookahead and stochastic acceptance.
limits: Public strict managed budgets still reject UnknownBound. This increment provides allocation-operation admission and lifetime protection, not complete native byte quotes or successful quoted-copy admission.
Drained host capture records still need complete shared-domain accounting beyond their cumulative capture quotas.

Checked model ownership promotion, reserved backing protection for ordinary escaped outputs, real public request admission and identity-backed opening-state accounting remain prerequisites for successful native managed budgets.
Complete paging/materialization/media/observation and distributed accounting remain part of the full goal; no missing path is classified as an architectural limitation.

Eight selected native tests were not run in this increment: the prediction-completion Metal case passed in the prior record, while five activation/component and two multiprocess ring cases have no new native evidence here.
Portable contracts and model equations were unchanged. No portable test suite, released-checkpoint numerics or peak-memory measurements were rerun for this backend ownership increment.
The final feature build retains 12 existing unused-helper warnings; native linking retains the existing large unwind-table warning.
corrected_validation_findings: Review found custom sample_processed callbacks can retain native arrays through interior mutable policy state. Shared sampler authority now preserves domains added by a later invocation when an earlier sampler clone survives.
The existing optimistic-transaction fixture directly indexed Array distributions. It now uses the test-only native inspection accessor while the distribution remains alive.
A redundant outer distribution re-export caused an unused-import warning and was removed; the implementation remains available through the opaque associated distribution type.
